name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 3 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-12-22, at wavelengths from 1.20 to 4.87 µm. The pipeline found 3 moving objects.
